summary: Twitch's main friction themes include app stability and performance issues, user experience and UI/UX problems, content moderation and policy concerns, and privacy and data usage concerns.

themes.name: App Stability and Performance
themes.description: Frequent app crashes, freezes, and bugs that make the app unusable on mobile devices, especially after recent updates. Issues include chat disappearing, stream freezing, and UI glitches that disrupt the user experience.
themes.recommendation: Prioritize bug fixes and performance improvements, especially for mobile users.

themes.name: Content Moderation and Policy Concerns
themes.description: Users are concerned about content moderation policies, including censorship, bans, and the handling of sensitive or controversial content. There are also concerns about the platform's role in content creation and monetization.
themes.recommendation: Clarify content policies and improve moderation transparency to build trust.

themes.name: Privacy and Data Usage
themes.description: Users are worried about privacy issues, including the app requesting access to personal data, age verification, and the use of user content for AI training without opt-in options.
themes.recommendation: Improve privacy controls and make data usage more transparent.

themes.name: User Experience and UI/UX
themes.description: Poor mobile UI design, confusing navigation, and layout changes that make it harder to use the app. Users are frustrated with the new layout and lack of customization options.
themes.recommendation: Revamp mobile UI/UX to improve navigation and user satisfaction.
